tasks.title: Document Compose, script and CLI reuse conventions
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy — Files, proposed entry, checks and completion evidence; Required behavior: The common entry; Acceptance evidence 1-3, 5-6; Non-goals, Risks and impact statements. Document reuse of common/services.yaml, scripts/, e2e/ and cli/ without changing those modules. Keep CLI logic small and pure; Docker, files and the network stay at the edge. No Compose, shell, CLI or CI change. Add ## Code conventions directly after ## Rules; extend a section already present on current main instead of adding a duplicate. Re-read current main before editing (inspected clone 9853c6d); apply the Counterexamples to the entry. Keep the existing bun run check gate (package.json:18). The section's Tool facts cite biome.json:2,13 and package.json:22, the shared Biome/check workflow files at pin 04108fa0c67d9a79c0f6d1ade4dd78df3ad8a4a7, and ci.yml:17,34-41; AGENTS.md is outside those tooling inputs. No new Compose or shell checks are introduced by this documentation change.

acceptance.expected: prints exactly AGENTS.md; no product code, test, CI, dependency, README.md, version or generated-output changes
empty output, grep exits 1: no existing lines removed
prints an integer at least 1; the exact canonical meta URL is present
prints exactly 200 for an unauthenticated request

Reading confirms: Add ## Code conventions directly after ## Rules; extend a section already present on current main instead of adding a duplicate. The entry names common/services.yaml, scripts/, e2e/ and cli/; it requires searching before writing, extracting the second copy into a shared helper, and small pure functions with effects at the existing boundary. Common prose is at most three lines after the heading. It links the convention without copying its seven rules or examples, preserves all existing text and stricter rules, and adds no enforcement or refactor.
exit 0 using the unchanged package.json:18 check script; report an unrelated baseline failure as a known limit without fixing out-of-scope files
no changed or untracked path except AGENTS.md (or empty output after committing); in particular no dist/, lockfile, test or tooling changes

The PR body names the issue and supplies the AGENTS.md-only diff, link/heading grep outputs, and the bun run check command and actual result. It records known limits; states documentation-only performance impact none expected and security impact no; and leaves Acceptance evidence 6 as a post-merge feature-close check with the main SHA and repeated link/meaning checks, without claiming it ran before merge.

acceptance.command: verified_main_sha=$(gh api repos/lorenzh/pulse-deploy/commits/main --jq .sha) && printf '%s\n' "$verified_main_sha" && gh api "repos/lorenzh/pulse-deploy/contents/AGENTS.md?ref=$verified_main_sha" --jq .content | base64 --decode
acceptance.expected: Deferred until feature close after this target PR merges (not a pre-merge task gate): record the main commit SHA returned by GitHub and read AGENTS.md at that exact SHA. Repeat Acceptance evidence 2-3 on that content: canonical URL present at least once, exactly 1 Code conventions heading, URL HTTP 200, and the three meanings. This implements this target's part of Acceptance evidence 6.
